object.attr: A backup has to be restorable: workouts are excluded from Android backup, so a new phone or a reinstall otherwise starts empty. Altitudes in the GPX files are smoothed on export, so a restored route holds the smoothed values; the elevation gain comes from the JSON file. Owner decision, 2026-10-31. Basis: owner decision.
object.description: When the user chooses an export archive through the import row on the Settings screen, the app shall add the workouts in the archive to the saved workouts.
